questions.q: The coordinates of the point at which minimum value of $Z = 7x - 8y$ subject to constraints $x + y - 20 \le 0, y \ge 5, x \ge 0, y \ge 0$& is attained, is
questions.solution:
Feasible region is $ABCA and Z = 7x - 8y$

At $A\left(0, 5\right), Z = 7 \times 0 - 8 \times 5 = - 40$

At $B\left(15, 5\right), Z = 7\left(15\right) - 8\left(5\right) = 65$

At $C\left(0, 20\right), Z = 7\left(0\right) - 8 \left(20\right) = - 160$

Hence, the minimum value of $Z$ is attained at point $\left(0, 20\right)$

So, option $\left(d\right)$ is correct.
